name: clean paired app-starter lockfile bump
why: Real incident (2026-11-15): the app starter keeps two byte-identical package-lock.json copies, 121,215 characters each; a card changing both was rejected as "changed files the reviewer can't read" for plain text, and the reviewer's next note asked for the very change that edits them. Both are readable text, so the reviewer judges them on the diff and approves the pins.

card.sentence: Push and open a draft PR for 1 branch.
card.reason: a product PR with a dependency pin, no gate code
